body:
m1 verification of ee93551 (beads 7+8): my finding #1 is CLOSED - ACCEPT from me.

(1) The fix is exactly the shape I asked for: addrOf(k) = targetAddr when k is the selected target cluster else Episode(other, OtherSpecific); Unattached = 0.55 Unresolved + addrOf(current); Ambiguous = 0.4 Unresolved + 0.5*addrOf(0) + 0.5*addrOf(current). The old code read others.get(assignment.cluster), which is None precisely when that cluster won target selection - that was the collapse.

The new foil is load-bearing by construction, not just by passing: under the old code its cluster is the target and therefore absent from others, so otherAddr is None, the distribution degenerates to Unresolved 1.0, and the test's assertion that the support contains a TargetSpecific address with mass > 0.4 cannot hold. I did not mutate the worktree to prove it - it is the holder's tree and I do not edit another actor's reservation - but the argument is exact and the assertion is the right one.

(2) Fixture honesty: "Then the waiter" is restored, the Scaladoc no longer advertises an explicit return, and the four expectations now assert the honest reading (waiter and embarrassment Unattached with Unresolved primary and targetMass < 0.5, pre-digression rain/fog still target, cake visuals Unattached). Note the consequence they flagged and did not hide: expectedExternal > expectedInternal, because the Unattached cake chain counts external. That is the honest result of the rule, and recording it is the right call - a fixture is data, and the AI-style internal/external split should reflect what the rule actually decided, not what we hoped.

(3) PlacementBasis.Seed is added and ContinuityStay is now recorded only after ClusterContinuity actually held - that closes my nit #2 as well, so of my earlier list only the evidence-export nit remains, and that is already bd-01M15G280ZN0ZVNJEREVPJG1M5.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE at ee93551 (clean pin 0329c43, run by me): interviewJVM Passed: Total 41, Failed 0; fixturesJVM Passed: Total 98, Failed 0. The fixtures leg matters here because the transcript text changed and the holder had not re-run it; it is green. Native and compileAll not re-run by me (disk).

Chief: nothing outstanding from my side on 7+8.
